rule_gaps: Bikes never wins over Sport for Foss Sport's bicycle catalogue: 63 rows here are bicycles or bike parts (dekk, slange, sykkelpumpe, krankdrev, kassett, skjerm, flaskeholder, ringeklokke, complete e-bikes) sitting in Sport — the shop publishes no srcCat, so CAT_RULES needs a bicycle vocabulary matched on the NAME (sykkel*, dekk 700x/29x, slange, skjerm/mudguard, kassett, kjede, krank*, sadel, flaskeholder, barnesykkel, e-bike model lines) ahead of the Sport floor

the word 'sport'/'sports' inside a MODEL or SKU string promotes to Sport: Sigma '…HSM Sports' lens mount → Photo, Comply 'Sport Pro' eartips whose breadcrumb leaf is the SKU 'COMSCSPORT1MX' → Audio, Merrell 'West Rim Sport'/'Snowcreek Sport' shoes → Shoes, Härkila 'Sporting' sweatshirt → Outdoor; a breadcrumb leaf that is an alphanumeric SKU should be skipped like CAT_WEAK
facetrules colour matching fires on non-colour words: 'MIX' (ski-skin fibre mix), 'Multi' in 'Step-Up Multi' and 'multi pack' all derive color=Multicolour

facetrules type has no mapping for the Sporttema cardio breadcrumbs 'Kondisjon / Stakemaskin' and 'Kondisjon / Promenadebånd', so ski ergometers and walking pads get no type; and 'Sportsbriller' derives type='Yoga & recovery' (Oakley Sutro), which is simply wrong

type='Apparel' is missing on most Norwegian garment nouns — Bukse, Vott, Hanske, Cap, sock/ankle sock, shorts and bra rows carry audience but no type; audience also misses the bare 'W ' women's prefix (only "W's" is recognised)
notes: Data is honest and prices are plausible; the health problem is placement, not content — one shop (Foss Sport, no srcCat) contributes a whole bicycle department that landed in Sport, and 90 of 266 rows have no image at all because their shops are sampled rather than crawled. Six obvious size-variant pairs (helmets, pads, mittens, gloves, poles, junior jerseys) sit as separate top-level rows; size suffixes appear in ~40 more names with no vlabel/family, which is worth one pass once the variant wiring is generalised.
